blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The House of Representatives will begin livestreaming the Budget Amendments Review Subcommittee (BARSc) proceedings starting Thursday afternoon, Oct. 1. This was confirmed by House Secretary General Atty. Cheloy E. Velicaria-Garafil, MNSA, which is scheduled to begin on Thursday at 1 p.m. “As in the previous year, all official BARSc proceedings will be livestreamed to ensure transparency and public access,” Garafil said in a statement issued on Wednesday evening. She added that the approved amendments during the deliberations will be publicly shown line by line to ensure transparency. READ: House set to discuss amendments to proposed 2027 budget The […]...
